# MERCH FROM THE CARGO HOLD [italic]Packed by hand at the Huygens docks by Precious's cousins. Prices in UA dollars. Ships with the next freighter going your way, which might be a while.[/italic]
## TAPES
- [bold]Afterglow Protocol[/bold], rainbow shell edition, $10. - [bold]Ninety Minutes from Home[/bold], violet shell, $8. - [bold]Cold Storage[/bold], blue shell reissue, $8. Not one of the original forty. Do not let anyone tell you otherwise.
## LISTENING GEAR
- [bold]Long Haul Tape Player[/bold], $35. A pocket cassette player, tough enough for a cargo bay and quiet enough for a shared bunk room. - [bold]Chroma Sleep Headphones[/bold], $25. Padded, so you can sleep in them. Lux does.
## WEAR IT
- [bold]Tour Shirt[/bold], $18. Every date on the back, including the ones that were cancelled. Especially those. - [bold]Huygens Dock Beanie[/bold], $12. Titan is cold. So is wherever you are.
## ALSO STOCKED BY Your colony canteen may carry the Company mixtape, which has one of our songs on it. We did not pick which one.
